summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Avory Foundational ETF (AVRY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in US-listed equities identified to represent the future needs of consumers, enterprises, and markets. AVRY was launched on Jan 22, 2026 and is issued by Avory.

holdings.infoBox: AVRY is an equity ETF with a total of 27 individual holdings. The top holdings are Okta, Inc. stock at 10.21%, Block at 7.50%, Zoom Communications at 6.58%, Meta Platforms at 6.34%, and Paycom Software at 6.05%.
